axis: Checked every seal twice. Nobody minded.
Has a notebook full of things worth a second look.
Said the true thing when it needed saying.
epi.plain: Kept the ship running, quietly and well. The logs say so, in small handwriting.
head: Seven ships made orbit. Nobody was left behind.
Seven ships, one planet, and every seal held.
story: a_window_hail
Set an answer running on day eighteen, and it was there in time.
a_window_quiet
Waited until close enough, then went to say hello in person.
m_carrier
Heard it first, called it ours, and checked.

Drew the wrong lighthouse in blue marker, and was right about the keeper.

Drew a lighthouse in blue marker, and slept through the night.

Wrote to every name on the list from the first call, from Mars.

Carried the seedling down in a coat pocket.

Carried a seed that never came up all the way to Mars, to plant it properly.

Said good night to a tray of seeds every night.

Read the last line of a letter aloud, at Mars.

Slept between the water tanks, because someone asked twice.

Slept between the water tanks, and patted them goodnight on the last night.

Patted the water tanks goodnight on the last night.

Topped the fleet's dose chart, and flew on.

Kept both timestamps. Still has them.

Pinned two traces side by side and never took them down.

Landed with a wrist that bends again.
